newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian girl killed, toll in two days at 9.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian girl killed, toll in two days at 9.

text.p: A Palestinian girl was shot dead in clashes with Israeli troops, raising to four the number of Palestinians killed in Gaza Strip violence on Thursday, health officials said.

An official in the Palestinian health ministry, Dr Faisal Abu Shahla, said a girl was brought shot dead to a clinic in the town of Deir al-Balah. He said she was between 14 and 16 years of age. But he had no further details. Nine Palestinians have died in two days of bloodshed.
